query: MATCH (sp:Spec) WHERE sp.specNumber IN ['38.201','38.202','38.211','38.212','38.213','38.214','38.215','38.291'] WITH DISTINCT sp.specNumber AS ts OPTIONAL MATCH (cr:CR)-[:MODIFIES]->(:Spec {specNumber:ts}) WITH ts,count(DISTINCT cr) AS crCount ORDER BY crCount DESC,ts ASC LIMIT 5 OPTIONAL MATCH (sec:Section)-[:BELONGS_TO_SPEC]->(:Spec {specNumber:ts}) RETURN ts,crCount,count(DISTINCT sec) AS sectionCount ORDER BY crCount DESC,ts ASC
